name: adr-mcp
description: Architectural Decision Records over MCP — search, author, validate, link, and trace decisions on disk.
long_description:
AdrMcp turns a folder of Markdown Architectural Decision Records (MADR 4.0) into live tools any MCP client can use: list and search decisions, draft new ones from a template, validate structure and links, supersede a decision while preserving its history, detect conflicts and stale decisions, and export a browsable index. Every mutating tool is preview-by-default — it returns a diff before anything touches disk.

Requires the **.NET 10 SDK** on your machine: this bundle launches the server on demand with `dnx` (the SDK's NuGet tool runner). Nothing is pre-installed — `dnx` fetches and caches the `AdrMcp` NuGet package on first use.

tools.name: list_adrs
tools.description: List and filter ADRs by status, tag, or date range.

tools.name: get_adr
tools.description: Get a single ADR by id or slug, optionally only selected sections.

tools.name: search_adrs
tools.description: Search ADRs — lexical by default, semantic term-vector ranking on request.

tools.name: get_adr_index
tools.description: The decision log: every ADR as a timeline entry.

tools.name: find_related_adrs
tools.description: Incoming/outgoing links and the supersession chain for an ADR.

tools.name: get_adr_graph
tools.description: The full ADR relationship graph (nodes and typed edges).

tools.name: create_adr
tools.description: Create an ADR from a MADR or Nygard template; preview-only by default.

tools.name: update_adr
tools.description: Replace or append a single section of an ADR; preview-only by default.

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Transition an ADR's status, enforcing the lifecycle.

tools.name: supersede_adr
tools.description: Create a replacement ADR, mark the old one superseded, and link both — in one call.

tools.name: link_adrs
tools.description: Create a typed link (supersedes/relates-to/conflicts-with) between two ADRs.

tools.name: validate_adr
tools.description: Validate ADR structure, status, and link integrity.

tools.name: find_stale_adrs
tools.description: ADRs whose code references no longer resolve.

tools.name: coverage_report
tools.description: ADR coverage per architectural area; surfaces decision gaps.

tools.name: suggest_adr_from_change
tools.description: Draft an ADR proposal from a unified diff.

tools.name: diff_adr
tools.description: Diff two ADRs, or an ADR file against its canonical rendering.
